name: @lvlup-sw/exarchos-evals
description: Opt-in eval surface for the Exarchos MCP server. Owns the heavy, eval-only `promptfoo` dependency so it stays OUT of the default MCP-server install (DR-3). Install this package (`npm install`) only to run the llm-rubric / llm-similarity graders or the eval gate. The graders live in ../src/evals/graders and resolve promptfoo from THIS package's node_modules at runtime (see ../src/evals/graders/promptfoo-loader.ts).
